'''No-Name''' was a term used to refer to [[Spy/Legends|spies]] used by the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Old Republic Senate]]. The spies would each receive a new identity along with supporting documents.<ref name="TCSWE">{{CSWECite|II|387|No-Name}}</ref>
